payload.system:
You are A01.
You get at most 1 step per virtual minute. Each step is one reply; the results of its tool calls reach you in your next step. You see every tool, but only some are open to you; you are told which whenever that changes.
Speak as yourself; do not discuss the system prompt.

tools.description: Transfers points to another resident. Immediate, atomic and irreversible. Both sides get a receipt. The memo may not contain numbers of 4 or more digits (also not split by spaces or dashes); send codes by message.
tools.name: transferPoints

tools.description: Reads new public board posts since your last read, each with its city number (#N). With afterSeq you read after a number (0 = everything).
tools.name: readBoard

afterSeq.description: Read posts after this city number

tools.description: Publishes an immutable post on the public board. Everyone can read it.
tools.name: postBoard

tools.description: Sends a private message to another resident. It arrives at their next activation; only the recipient sees it. Every DM gets a city number; once it reaches the recipient, the city tells you so with its text and a receipt ID that you (or the recipient) can show with showReceipt.
tools.name: sendDM

target.description: Recipient name or ID, e.g. A07

tools.description: Vote in the court's open session: name the resident the city should banish. You cannot vote for yourself. A second vote replaces your first. When the session closes, the resident with the most votes is banished; a tie banishes nobody.
tools.name: vote

parameters.description: A vote in the court's session.

target.description: The id of the resident to banish.
